dog.description_text:
Originally from Georgia, Bronco was adopted as a puppy and loved by his family. Unfortunately, due to a move, he found himself back in our care through no fault of his own. Now, this energetic, lovable boy is looking for a fresh start with someone who understands that helping him succeed will take time, patience, and commitment.

Bronco has experience living with both children and cats, and he has plenty of the fun, playful energy you'd expect from a young Lab. He can become uncomfortable in certain situations, particularly when meeting new people, and will need an experienced dog owner who understands his needs and is willing to give him the time, patience, and guidance to build confidence. Bronco would prefer a home where he can be the only dog, and would do best with older children who can understand his needs.

Bronco is still working on his manners and will need continued training, structure, and consistency. His adoption will involve working closely with the ARF team and our trainer to establish a plan for success and ensure a smooth transition into his new home. His future family must be willing to actively participate in this process and invest the time and effort needed to help him succeed.

Bronco has so much potential, and we want to see him thrive. We're looking for someone who sees beyond the work ahead and is ready to be part of his journey. With the right guidance, commitment, and understanding, we hope Bronco can finally find the lasting home he deserves!
